command: ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild -x generateFrontendAssetManifest -x verifyFrontendAssets --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair admits exact aggregate generated C index evidence bytes and refuses one below before dispatch' --no-daemon

scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: SourceTreeGenerator produces valid plan/model evidence with one function, one global, and one type. At maximumIndexEvidenceBytes=34033, the full aggregate evidence is admitted; scripted ACP acknowledges a replacement and readback, and an injected validator verifies candidate bytes plus profile, index, and source-revision bindings before throwing its expected sentinel. The receipt reaches the final workspace snapshot and records verified process/sandbox cleanup. At maximumIndexEvidenceBytes=34032, the plan fits but the program model exceeds the remaining aggregate allowance by one byte; active graph admission returns the exact typed stable-file diagnostic before ACP dispatch or candidate validation. Sources and evidence remain unchanged, no graph/run/history attempt is retained, and a subsequent graph open at the exact limit succeeds.
